{
  "summary": "A rollout has been running for 20 minutes without completing, exceeding the default 10‑minute progress deadline.",
  "likely_cause": "The Deployment has exceeded its .spec.progressDeadlineSeconds, causing the Progressing condition to be set to False with reason ProgressDeadlineExceeded, indicating a stalled rollout.",
  "confidence": "high",
  "next_action": [
    "Run `kubectl rollout status deployment/<name>` to confirm the error and see the exit code.",
    "Describe the Deployment with `kubectl describe deployment <name>` and inspect the `Progressing` condition and `Events` section for details (e.g., readiness probe failures, image pull errors, quota issues).",
    "If the issue is identified (e.g., failing pods), correct the underlying problem (fix probes, image, permissions, etc.) and resume the rollout.",
    "Optionally, rollback to the previous version using `kubectl rollout undo deployment/<name>` if a quick recovery is needed.",
    "After fixing, re‑trigger the rollout or resume it, then verify success with `kubectl rollout status` and `kubectl get deployment <name>`."
  ]
}
